title: FormLayoutDescriptor
description: Describes the visual layout of a form as tabs, groups, rows, and field cells.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: the layout is a tree: tabs -> groups -> rows -> cells. Each cell `fieldId` must reference a field from the form's `fields` array. Use `colSpan` 4 for full-width fields, 2+2 for two columns, or 1+1+1+1 for four compact controls. The total effective width in a row should not exceed 4.

tabs.description: Ordered list of tabs in the form. Use one default tab named 'main' for simple forms.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tab. Prefer camelCase/kebab-case such as 'main' or 'advanced'.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default tab. The designer uses the default tab as the safe target for orphaned fields.

groups.description: Ordered list of groups within this tab. Use one default group for simple forms.

id.description: Unique identifier for this group. Rules can target group ids.

title.description: Optional display title for the group. Use null or omit for an untitled group.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default group. The designer uses the default group as the safe target for orphaned fields.

rows.description: Ordered list of layout rows; each row contains one or more cells placed side-by-side.

cells.description: Fields placed side-by-side in this row. The sum of colSpan values should not exceed 4.

fieldId.description: Reference to a field id in the form's fields array. Every field shown in the layout needs a matching field descriptor.

colSpan.description: Number of grid columns this field spans from 1 to 4. Use 4 for full-width fields.

colStart.description: Starting grid column from 1 to 4. Omit or null to auto-place after the previous cell.
